Petitioner  Versus  1. The State of Bihar  2. Smt. Sulekha Kumari Wife of Kundan Kumar Arya Resident of under care  of Father Kaahai Das, Resident of village - Khapda, P.S.- Sangrampur,
 District - Munger, State - Bihar.

==
 Appearance :
 For the Petitioner : Mr.Brajesh Sahay, Advocate  Miss. Harshita, Advocate
For the State : Mr.Ram Sevak Choudhary, APP
: HONOURABLE MR. JUSTICE PRABHAT KUMAR SINGH  ORAL ORDER 3 18-09-2023 Heard learned counsel for the petitioner and the State.
2. Petitioner apprehends arrest in a case registered for the offence punishable under sections 323,498A/504 of the Indian Penal Code and section 3 & 4 of the Dowry Prohibition Act.
3. It is a case of torture and harassment for dowry.
4. Petitioner happens to be husband of opposite party no.2.
In paragraph 13 of the bail petition, it is submitted that the petitioner has been granted decree of divorce vide order dated 27.8.2022, by the Family Court, Munger.
In the said case, opposite party no.2, though appeared but she did not contest the Divorce Matrimonial case no.174 of 2018.
5. Considering the aforesaid development, prayer for bail of all the petitioners is allowed.
In the event of arrest/surrender within six weeks from today, let these petitioners, mentioned above, be enlarged on bail on furnishing Patna High Court CR.
